steps.content: Temperatures at sea change drastically. Soon, your breaths fog in the frigid air.
The room grows colder by the minute. Shin shivers in her thin, damp clothes, yet she drapes the only blanket over Laura.

steps.speaker: Shin
steps.content: Your injuries are worse. Stay warm.
Laura was in the lab during the collision and was struck by fallen instruments. She's barely managing to stay conscious.

steps.speaker: Captain Edmond
steps.content: The temperature's dropping too fast... At this rate, the injured won't last until we reach shore.
The crewman you met earlier in the lower cabins hobbles forward, leaning on a metal pipe.

steps.speaker: Crew Member
steps.content: It's the boiler room. I saw it during the crash, but didn't have time to fix it... I'll handle it now.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Your leg...?

steps.speaker: Crew Member
steps.content: Just a sprain. It's nothing.
To prove his point, he lifts the pipe and hops on the spot, but the twitch in his face gives him away.
Even so, he's still in better shape than most of the survivors.

steps.speaker: Captain Edmond
steps.content: Alright. But we need one more person, for safety.
Reid stares down at the axe gripped tightly in his hand, face rigid, but never moves to stand. The captain gives his shoulder an understanding pat and makes the call.

steps.speaker: Captain Edmond
steps.content: Shin needs to tend to the wounded. Our guide will keep us on course and watch for threats. I'll go with two of our repair crew.

steps.speaker: Captain Edmond
steps.content: Reid, I'm leaving the wheelhouse to you. Keep everyone safe.
Reid looks taken aback. Then, he nods with resolve.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Wait, the lower decks... they aren't safe. The comms are down. What if you run into danger? How do you call for help?
The captain takes the metal pipe from the crewman and waves it confidently.

steps.speaker: Captain Edmond
steps.content: Tapping signals. The ship has a metal hull. The sound carries. We tap on the walls down there, you'll hear it up here.

steps.speaker: Captain Edmond
steps.content: That's a sailor's wisdom for you. Don't underestimate our crew!
They head out without further ado. The crewman turns in the doorway and waves.

steps.speaker: Crew Member
steps.content: Hang in there. We'll be back soon.
Soon, clear tapping sounds come from the metal walls. Those left behind begin their long, silent vigil, nerves stretched taut.
